title: EvalQualityResponse
description:
Production-eval quality: overall pass-rate/score, per-eval-key breakdown, and a trend.

The channel-agnostic quality surface. Returns zeroed shapes (empty ``by_eval_key``
and ``trend``, null rates) when no verdicts exist for the workspace/window — the
console renders an empty-state rather than erroring, so this ships safely ahead of
the eager-eval trigger being enabled in production.

trend.title: Trend
trend.description: Time series of eval pass-rate/score per interval bucket

eval_key.title: Eval Key
eval_key.description: Eval key for a per-key row; null for the overall summary

total_evals.title: Total Evals
total_evals.description: Total verdicts recorded (any status, incl. errored)

judged.title: Judged
judged.description: Verdicts with a non-null pass/fail outcome (denominator for pass_rate)

pass_rate.title: Pass Rate
pass_rate.description: Fraction of judged verdicts that passed (0.0-1.0)

avg_score.title: Avg Score
avg_score.description: Mean numeric judge score across scored verdicts

EvalQualitySummary.title: EvalQualitySummary
EvalQualitySummary.description:
Aggregate production-eval verdict stats, overall or for one eval_key.

Sourced from ``call_eval_results`` (LLM-judge + assertion verdicts), which is
keyed by ``conversation_id`` and therefore CHANNEL-AGNOSTIC — voice, text,
SMS, email all contribute equally, unlike the voice-shaped call-quality score.

judged.title: Judged
judged.description: Verdicts with a non-null pass/fail outcome in this bucket

pass_rate.title: Pass Rate
pass_rate.description: Fraction of judged verdicts that passed in this bucket

avg_score.title: Avg Score
avg_score.description: Mean numeric judge score in this bucket

EvalQualityTrendPoint.title: EvalQualityTrendPoint
EvalQualityTrendPoint.description: Single date-bucket data point in the eval-quality trend series.
